meta.title: ReproSense
meta.description: A private record of cycles, pain scores and lab results that her gynaecologist can read in a minute. It shows the entries behind every pattern and never diagnoses. Demo with fictional data.
meta.ogAlt: ReproSense, a woman's cycle record prepared for her doctor

chrome.footer: ReproSense gives information, not a diagnosis. In an emergency call 998. Demo data is fictional. Built with AI tools.

demo.title: Eight fictional women, five life stages, one clinic network.
demo.intro: Each woman has twelve months of generated daily logs, lab reports and events. Every number in this demo comes from the build kit's synthetic data generator.
demo.staffIntro: The clinician sees only women who shared a report. The network admin sees follow-ups across clinics, without names.
demo.resetDone: Demo data reset. You're now signed in as the clinic network admin.

need.patient: Pick a woman below to open her app.
need.clinician: Open the clinician view to see the clinic's patients.
need.admin: Open the clinic network to see follow-ups across clinics.

demo.apiDownBody: Start the API with make api in the repository folder, then try again.

insights.title: Patterns
insights.intro: What we noticed in your entries. Written rules decide, published guidelines ground each card, and nothing here is a diagnosis.
insights.strengthDetail: {cycles, plural, one {# cycle} other {# cycles}} logged · {entries} entries
insights.why: Why we noticed (tap a day to open it)
insights.written: {by, select, claude {Written by the language model and checked} other {Written from a template}} · {verified, plural, one {# sentence} other {# sentences}} matched to a source{dropped, plural, =0 {} one {, # removed} other {, # removed}}
insights.noneBody: When your entries match a pattern doctors look at, it appears here with the days behind it and its source. Keep logging; we check every time you save.
insights.traceIntro: Every card goes through the same steps. Rules decide; the language model only explains, and every sentence is checked against a source.

agents.signal: Signal: runs the written rules (no AI)

agents.care_gap: Care gaps: opens or closes follow-ups

insights.crisisIntro: Patterns are hidden while you get support.

assistant.subtitle: Answers from curated guidelines, with sources

assistant.notGrounded: Some sentences couldn't be matched to a source and were left out.
assistant.disclaimer: Information, not a diagnosis. In an emergency call 998.
assistant.empty: Pick a suggested question or type your own.
